Bombay HC Discharges Rahul Raj Singh in Pratyusha Banerjee Abetment Case

The Bombay High Court has discharged Rahul Raj Singh, the ex-boyfriend of television actress Pratyusha Banerjee, from a case of abetment of suicide. The decision comes 10 years after Banerjee's death. The court's ruling means Singh is no longer facing charges related to her suicide.
